newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: SOCCER-FRENCH COACH FOR IVORY COAST.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FRENCH COACH FOR IVORY COAST.

text.p: Ivory Coast have named Robert Nouzaret, current general manager of French first division club Montpellier, as their new coach.
A cabinet statement published in the government newspaper Fraternite Matin on Saturday said Nouzaret had been taken on for three years.
Ivory Coast have failed to qualify for the 1998 World Cup in France and are unlikely to qualify for the next edition of the African Nations Cup, a tournament they won in 1992.
